blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Страшнее надо, страшнее, ___ (угрозный)!
exercises.why: The comparative degree of Russian adjectives is formed by adding "-ее" (sometimes shortened to "-ей") to the stem of the adjective: новый — новее; красивый — красивее. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 80, 82.  ·  From Максим Горький, «Достигаев и другие».
